items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: But as for John Robichaux's officers down there, the officers that John sent out under Wendell McNeil. Wendell was his conductor until he come on the scene. And when John come on the scene, John is king.

ctx.x: You're not talking about anybody except to say something good about the old music. He said a little bit about Duke, but he needs to be straight.

Yeah, he should be criticized. He should be. But as for John Robichaux's officers down there, the officers that John sent out under Wendell McNeil. Wendell was his conductor until he come on the scene. And when John come on the scene, John is king. And John take over that left-hand fiddle and start playing. And the people stop John. Hey, John, come here.
